text:
Lina Chen: Quick copy check on the API keys modal — the 'Revoke API key' dialog feels abrupt. Screenshot: https://redwood/mockups/revoke-dialog.png

Alex Patel: Yeah reads a bit punitive. Also keyboard focus currently lands on the red 'Revoke' button 1 risky for accidental presses. :thinking: 

Maya Singh: Agreed. Default focus should be on the safe action. Also add a one-line impact note so admins know what stops working.

Chris O'Neil: Draft copy:

Headline: "Revoke API key?"
Body: "This key will stop working immediately. Update clients before revoking."
Buttons: [Cancel] [Revoke key]

Make Cancel the default focus and prevent Enter from triggering Revoke. Add aria-describedby linking to the body text.

Lina Chen: I suggested: "This key will stop working immediately and any running requests may fail. Create a replacement key before revoking." Too long?

Alex Patel: Prefer shorter: "This key will stop working immediately. Update clients before revoking." Link to the API key docs for details.

Maya Singh: Accessibility checklist: focus trap, default focus on Cancel, Esc cancels, Enter triggers Cancel when focused, visible focus styles, aria-label on destructive button like "Revoke API key: <name>".

DesignBot: A11y ticket created: "Revoke API key dialog - focus and semantics". See /docs/a11y/dialogs#revoke-key.

Chris O'Neil: Also add a tiny tooltip on the keys list row: "Revoking is irreversible 1 create replacement first." Short and scannable.

Lina Chen: I'll update Figma and open a small PR with the copy + a11y changes and tooltip text.

Alex Patel: @Maya can you review the PR when it's up?

Maya Singh: Yep, will review.

Lina Chen: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
